biggest_catch: The sponsor (you) must already be an active PSI Propane customer in good standing for at least 45 days before any referral credit is issued to either party — new customers cannot refer immediately.
catches: You must be an active PSI Propane customer in good standing for at least 45 days before referral credits are issued to you or the referred customer.
Credits are only applied after the first delivery has been completed on the referral's account (or after a meter is installed for metered propane customers).
Only one referral credit is awarded per account activation.
Customers enrolled under Corporate Account pricing are not eligible.
Offer may be modified or canceled at any time; credits are non-transferable.
Rewards are account credits that offset planned propane spending, never income or cash.
Refer as many as you like, but 12+ people referred in a calendar year ($900+ in credits) could trigger a 1099 tax form.

steps: As an existing PSI Propane customer in good standing (at least 45 days), refer a friend via the referral form.
The referred customer activates a new PSI Propane account.
The new customer completes their first propane delivery (or has a meter installed for metered service).
A $75 account credit is applied to your account; the referred customer gets a $25 credit.
